table.retrieve:
select  
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.customicode, 
	Active = CASE Item.Active WHEN 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	Category=(select name from itemcategory where icatcode=item.icatcode),
	saleqty = IsNull(
		(SELECT qty = Sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty)
		FROM dbo.saleledger, dbo.saledetail    
		WHERE dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
			dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
			/*dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and*/
			dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:aa_saletype) and
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
			dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode 
		GROUP BY saledetail.icode ),0) +
		IsNull(
		(SELECT qty = Sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM dbo.saleledger, dbo.saleinvdetail sd
		WHERE DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
			dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
			dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
			/*dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and*/
			dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:aa_saletype) and
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
			sd.icode = item.icode 
		GROUP BY sd.icode ),0),
	salediscount = IsNull(
		(SELECT Round(Sum (Round( (SLD.looseqty * ( SLD.saleprice - SLD.itemflatdisc)) * (SLD.discperc * .01 )+ ((SLD.looseqty * ( SLD.saleprice - SLD.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - SLD.discperc * .01 ))*SL.discperc*0.01 + (SLD.looseqty * SLD.itemflatdisc),2) ), 2)
		FROM saleledger SL, saledetail SLD
		WHERE SL.date >= :ad_StartDate and
			SL.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
			/*SL.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and*/
			SL.salecatcode IN (:aa_saletype) and
			SL.saleinvcode = SLD.saleinvcode and  
			SLD.icode = item.icode 
		GROUP BY SLD.icode ),0) +
		IsNull(
		(SELECT Round(Sum (Round( (sd.looseqty * ( sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) * (sd.discperc * .01 )+ ((sd.looseqty * ( sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - sd.discperc * .01 ))*saleledger.discperc*0.01 + (sd.looseqty * sd.itemflatdisc),2) ), 2)
		FROM dbo.saleledger, dbo.saleinvdetail sd
		WHERE  DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
			dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
			dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
			/*dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and*/
			dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:aa_saletype) and
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
			sd.icode = item.icode 
		GROUP BY sd.icode ),0),
	saleAmount=IsNull(
		(SELECT Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice), 2)
		FROM dbo.saleledger, dbo.saledetail
		WHERE  dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
			dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
			/*dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and*/
			dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:aa_saletype) and
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
			dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode 
		GROUP BY saledetail.icode ),0) + 
		IsNull((SELECT Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty * sd.saleprice), 2)
		FROM dbo.saleledger, dbo.saleinvdetail sd
		WHERE  DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
			dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
			dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
			/*dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and*/
			dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (:aa_saletype) and
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
			sd.icode = item.icode 
		GROUP BY sd.icode ),0),
	srqty=IsNull((SELECT qty = Sum(dbo.srdetail.looseqty)
		FROM dbo.srledger, dbo.srdetail    
		WHERE dbo.srledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
			dbo.srledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
			dbo.srledger.srcatcode IN (:aa_srtype) and
			dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode and  
			dbo.srdetail.icode = item.icode 
		GROUP BY srdetail.icode ),0),
	netsramount=IsNull(( SELECT SUM(SRD.LooseQty * SRD.SrPrice *
		(1 - SRD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SRL.DiscPerc * 0.01) )	
		/*Round(Sum ( SRD.looseqty * SRD.srprice), 2)
		- Round(Sum (Round( SRD.looseqty * ( SRD.srprice * SRD.discperc * .01 ) ,2)),2)
		- Round(Sum (Round( (SRD.srprice * ( SRD.looseqty - SRD.discperc * .01 ))*SRL.discperc*0.01 ,2)),2)
		*/
		FROM dbo.srledger SRL, dbo.srdetail  SRD  
		WHERE  SRL.date >= :ad_StartDate and
			SRL.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
			SRL.srcatcode IN (:aa_srtype) and
			SRL.srinvcode = SRD.srinvcode and  
			SRD.icode = item.icode 
		GROUP BY SRD.icode ),0)/*,
	srdiscount=IsNull(( SELECT Round(Sum (Round( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * ( dbo.srdetail.srprice * dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01 ) ,2)),2)
		FROM dbo.srledger, dbo.srdetail    
		WHERE  dbo.srledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
			dbo.srledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and 
			dbo.srledger.srcatcode IN (:aa_srtype) and
			dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode and  
			dbo.srdetail.icode = item.icode 
			
			GROUP BY srdetail.icode ),0) */
from item
where item.icatcode IN (:ll_icatcode)
order by Category,
item.name
